name: How long does it take to install recessed lighting in a kitchen in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install recessed lighting in a kitchen in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to install recessed lighting in a kitchen in Berkeley depends on several factors, including the number of lights, accessibility of the ceiling, and whether new wiring is required. A typical installation for a moderately sized kitchen might take one to three days. If existing drywall needs to be cut and repaired, it could extend the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 1-3 days, depending on the number of lights, ceiling accessibility, and wiring requirements.
